docs.title: API integration
docs.subtitle: Real data from your academy to connect your store (WooCommerce, n8n, Zapier…). Check the groups or courses and copy the exact payload.
docs.authDescription: Every call carries a tenant key in the header.
docs.whatInscribe: Enroll: creates/reuses the buyer and grants access (groups and/or courses).
docs.whatCourses: Catalog with status (only PUBLISHED ones allow enrollment).
docs.whatCommunityPost: Posts to the community as the admin who owns the key.
docs.groupsDescription: The group is what grants visibility of one or more courses. It is the recommended path for packs and memberships: removing it revokes by refcount.
docs.coursesDescription: Only PUBLISHED ones allow enrollment: a draft course is reported as COURSE_NOT_PUBLISHED.
docs.payloadPickPrompt: Check at least one group or course above to generate the exact body.
docs.payloadGenerated: Generated with the real identifiers you checked.
docs.communityDescription: POST /api/v1/community-api/posts creates a post in the feed signed by the admin who owns the key — each admin uses their own key (scope community:post) and there are no tokens to renew. API posts are audited in Community → API posts.
docs.noteBody: 1–10,000 characters; it renders as a regular post.
docs.noteSpace: Slug of the space to post in (422 if it does not exist; without it the post goes to “general”)
docs.noteTags: Additional tags (max. 10; the space already goes as a tag).
docs.noteNotifyAll: With <codeChip>true</codeChip>, besides publishing it sends the notice by EMAIL + bell to ALL members.
docs.noteImportant: With notifyAll: it ignores the recipient notification opt-out.
docs.noteCourseId: Links the post to a course.
docs.adminKeyNote: The key must belong to an admin (super_admin / tenant_admin): if the owner stops being an admin, the key can no longer post. Response: the created post with its id.

rateLimit.title: API limits
rateLimit.subtitle: Per-minute quotas the API applies to your organization. If you exceed the limit you receive a 429 Too Many Requests response with Retry-After and X-RateLimit-* headers.
rateLimit.planComparisonDescription: Per-minute, per-tenant figures. Buckets are independent — a public traffic spike does not consume your authenticated quota.
rateLimit.upgradeDescription: The Enterprise plan multiplies the limits by ~10x. Recommended if your integration polls aggressively, syncs Fundae XML at month-end close or serves a public portal with seasonal traffic.

scim.title: SCIM Provisioning
scim.subtitle: Lets your IdP (Okta, Azure AD, Auth0, Google Workspace) create, update and deactivate users in Didacta automatically — without your team having to maintain duplicate lists.
scim.statusLoadError: Could not load the SCIM status.
scim.confirmRotate: Generate a new token? The current token will be revoked and the IdP will receive 401 until you paste the new one.
scim.confirmRevoke: Revoke the SCIM token? The IdP will receive 401 immediately and will stop provisioning users.
scim.createError: Could not generate the token. Try again.
scim.revokeError: Could not revoke the token. Try again.
scim.tokenDescription: The IdP sends this token as Authorization: Bearer … on every request to /scim/v2/Users. Per-tenant.
scim.tokenMeta: Created {created} · {hasLastUsed, select, true {last used {lastUsed}} other {not used by the IdP yet}}
scim.noToken: You have not generated a SCIM token yet. Generate one so the IdP can start provisioning.
scim.endpointDescription: Configure this URL in the SCIM panel of the IdP. Per-tenant — the token resolves the organization.
scim.configureIdpDescription: Generic steps that apply to Okta / Azure AD / Auth0 / Google Workspace. Field names may vary slightly between IdPs.
scim.step1Title: 1. Create the SCIM app in the IdP
scim.step1Description: In the IdP application catalog, search for “SCIM 2.0” or create a custom app with “SCIM Provisioning” enabled.
scim.step2Description: Paste the URL from the previous section into the SCIM Connector base URL field (Okta) / Tenant URL (Azure AD) / similar.
scim.step3Description: Paste the token generated above into the OAuth Bearer Token / Secret Token field. Set the auth method to Bearer.
scim.step4Description: Map userName to the user email, name.givenName and name.familyName to the name fields, and active to the user status field in the IdP.
scim.step5Description: The IdP usually has a “Test Connection” button — pressing it makes a GET /scim/v2/ServiceProviderConfig. If it responds 200, you are done.
scim.usersOnlyTitle: Note: Users only in this pilot
scim.usersOnlyDescription: Groups (group sync) is NOT supported yet — IdPs will try it and receive 501 Not Implemented or 404. Role assignments are still managed from Users.
scim.upsellDescription: SCIM 2.0 (System for Cross-domain Identity Management) is part of the Didacta Enterprise package. It lets your IdP (Okta, Azure AD, Auth0, Google Workspace) create, update and deactivate users in Didacta automatically — without your team having to maintain duplicate lists.
scim.upsellCapability: The required capability is feat:scim. Without Enterprise, the /scim/v2/Users endpoints return 402 Payment Required and IdPs cannot provision.

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.subtitle: The events the platform sends out to your systems and the ones coming in from Zoom.
webhooks.outboundIntro: External URLs that receive a notification every time an event happens on the platform (a student completes a course, a new community post, etc.). Useful to integrate with internal systems (Slack, CRM, ERP) or n8n / Zapier automations.
webhooks.loadError: Could not load the outbound webhooks information.
webhooks.planComparisonDescription: In Community, deliveries are best-effort synchronous (1 retry). In Enterprise, BullMQ with exponential retries, HMAC-SHA256 signing and persisted dead-letter.
webhooks.deadLetterEnterprise: Yes — manual retry from the UI
webhooks.emptyEndpoints: You have not configured any endpoint yet. Press “New endpoint” to create the first one.
webhooks.limitReached: You reached your plan limit. Delete one or upgrade to Enterprise to raise the limit to {max}.
webhooks.eventsRequired: Enter at least one event type (comma-separated).
webhooks.saveSecretNow: Save this secret NOW. We will not show it again on any other screen.
webhooks.maxEventTypes: Your plan allows at most {max} types per endpoint.
webhooks.enterprisePathBadge: You are on the Enterprise path
webhooks.deadLetterDescription: Events whose deliveries exhausted the 5 exponential retries. Retry manually or dismiss after fixing the cause.
webhooks.deadLetterEmpty: No dead-letter entries. All recent deliveries succeeded.
webhooks.upsellDescription: On your current plan, failed deliveries are logged and discarded. In Enterprise, they are recorded in a dead-letter tray with manual retry + Prometheus metrics (P50/P95/P99 latency, queue depth, success rate per endpoint).
webhooks.upgradeTitle: Does your integration need more reliability?
webhooks.upgradeDescription: Enterprise raises you to 20 endpoints per tenant, unlimited events, HMAC signing, exponential retries and persisted dead-letter. Recommended if your webhooks feed billing, CRM or critical systems.

zoom.description: Traceability of the events received from the Zoom webhook. Useful to diagnose sessions that do not transition or recordings that never show up.
